summary: Fixes films and series so they play directly on your chosen devices, without Jellyfin converting them as they play.
does: Direct play checks each film and series file and fixes what stops your chosen devices playing it directly: the wrong container, a sound track the device cannot play, very large H.264 files, or old picture formats. It fixes one file at a time, at the lowest priority, in the hours you choose.

Before a new file replaces the old one it checks the length, picture, first sound track, timing and subtitles. A file that fails is left as it was and listed with the reason. Then Reelix and Jellyfin are told the file changed.
for: People whose televisions, sticks or browsers make Jellyfin convert films as they play, and who want that done once, quietly, instead of every time.
needs: Jellyfin added to Starboard, and a Reelix key. It changes files in the movies and tv folders of your media folder, so you must choose which devices you play on. It needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later.
shows: Two dashboard cards: Direct play, showing what is converting now, what is next and the totals, and Space saved by Direct play. Its settings have a Files page, a switch for each device, When it works, shrink limits, Keep the originals, and buttons to pause, resume and check the library.
